fusions.name: Sounding Ping
fusions.desc: Sends out a ping that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stunning Click
fusions.desc: Fires a focused click that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Lightless Dive
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 9 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Blackwater Hunter
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 4%.
